draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.66, the 229th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 33rd of 35 at WR. He lasted until pick 258, well after his grade rank (229th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (14th percentile). College production: 1,188 receiving yards in 2020, 6th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2022. 28 career games and 2 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (5th percentile), receiving yards 37 (9th percentile).
